content: If a Sd server receives a SubscribeEventgroup entry and client end point is assigned to a socket connection, the server shall call SoAd_IsConnection- Ready() for this socket connection and client endpoint: • If the function returns TCPIP_E_OK, the server shall respond with Sub- scribeEventgroupAck. • For all other return values the server shall discard the entry and respond with SubscribeEventgroupNack.
